purpose: separate information insufficiency in the legal B/T/R observables from representation/Evidence-processing limitation and from open-world learning/transfer limitation, for Evidence-conditioned open-world recovery. Diagnostic only; no deployable method; no new detector.
primary_metric: pooled AUROC of RK-vs-TU scoring (TU positive); every scientific claim decided on pooled AUROC increments

materiality_floor.rule: point estimate >= +0.02 AND 95% bootstrap CI lower > 0 (pooled family level)
materiality_floor.per_rotation: material direction = point estimate >= +0.02 only; per-rotation CI lower NOT required; per-rotation CIs used only for the reverse-effect check (CI upper < 0 = clear reverse)
materiality_floor.rationale: preregistered project feasibility threshold, not a universal statistical standard

frozen_populations.master_split: gate_seed_20260817_targets.parquet (175,000 TRAIN / 56,000 VALIDATION; group-atomic, 0 straddling groups)
frozen_populations.rk_rows: frozen recoverable==1 AND is_unknown==0 (Basic-wrong acquired Known recovered by a legal Evidence state)
frozen_populations.tu_rows: frozen rotation is_unknown mask (8,000 per rotation)

views.RAW_LEGAL: 83 dims: basic 47 + T block 16 + R block 18 + availability masks m_t/m_r (state-presence)
views.STATE_TRANSITION: 26 dims: RF pre/post (p_top, margin, argmax) + deltas + stability; EDL pre/post (S, p_top, p_2nd, argmax) + deltas; Mahalanobis pre/post/delta; evidence-type one-hot (T, R, TR)
views.probe_assignment: Probe A runs both views; Probe B runs RAW_LEGAL only

controls.BASIC: state-B features (T/R neutral, masks 0); STATE_TRANSITION post=pre (deltas 0, stability 1, flags 0)
controls.SHUFFLED: T/R blocks permuted within (RK, TU) separately; rng cell_rng(20260817, rot, 171000+400); STATE_TRANSITION recomputed from frozen components
controls.NULL_PRESENT: T/R blocks zeroed, masks present (=1 for acquired types)

A.name: DIAGNOSTIC_SEPARABILITY
A.supervision: RK-vs-TU labels (TU positive) from frozen rotation masks on role-0 rows
A.fold_target_C: dev = role-0 rows of rotations A+B (per-rotation labels and frozen chains); test = role-1 rows of rotation C
A.interpretation: supports the Evidence hypothesis ONLY through incremental target-matched REAL Evidence beyond BASIC AND SHUFFLED; high BASIC-only AUROC does not support Evidence sufficiency; diagnostic TU supervision never reused for deployable methods

B.name: KNOWN_ONLY_TRANSFER
B.target_exact: Y_correct_post = 1 iff frozen post-Evidence Known prediction (frozen RF at acquired state) equals the Known ground-truth class
B.training: all 175,000 TRAIN-partition rows with rotation-C-conditioned features (acquired states from frozen rotation-C selectors + typed_policy_actions, budget floor(0.15 x 175,000)=26,250 over the full TRAIN partition)
B.tu_use: TU never used for fitting or threshold selection
B.threshold: per fold, 95th percentile of probe score over rotation-C role-0 Known rows
B.evaluation: primary recovery evaluation = frozen RK (Basic-wrong) vs held-out TU separately; overall Known correctness reported as diagnostic only

model_families.RF: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=80, max_depth=20, min_samples_leaf=2, class_weight=balanced_subsample, n_jobs=-1, random_state=20260817)
model_families.LR: L2 logistic regression C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter=1000, standardized on fit rows only
model_families.MLP: fixed 2-layer (input->64 ReLU->1), AdamW 3e-4 / wd 1e-4, batch 1024, max 20 epochs, early stop patience 3 on deterministic 90/10 split, torch.manual_seed(20260817), standardized as LR
model_families.fits: probe A 18 (3 families x 2 views x 3 folds) + probe B 9 (3 families x 1 view x 3 folds) = 27

consistency_rules.family_materiality: mat(P,v,f) iff pooled REAL-BASIC >= +0.02 AND CI lower > 0 AND pooled REAL-SHUFFLED >= +0.02 AND CI lower > 0
consistency_rules.rotation_consistency: rotOK(P,v): >=2/3 rotations with median-across-families per-rotation REAL-BASIC >= +0.02 AND REAL-SHUFFLED >= +0.02 (point estimates), AND no rotation with median CI upper < 0 on either comparison (clear reverse)
consistency_rules.shortcut: GENERIC_EVIDENCE_SHORTCUT_DOMINANT iff A (n(A,RAW)=0) AND B (SHUFFLED-BASIC >= +0.02 with pooled CI lower > 0 in >=2/3 families) AND C (rotOK_sb on SHUFFLED-BASIC) AND D (REAL not materially over SHUFFLED)
consistency_rules.retention: BOTTLENECK iff min(median ret_b, median ret_s) < 0.5, ret(f)=inc(ST,f)/inc(RAW,f) for f in S(A,RAW); point-estimate decision; bootstrap uncertainty reported as reporting-only

decision_tree.dry_run: 1,024 hypothetical metric combinations; exactly one outcome each; all six outcomes reachable; 0 violations; no absolute-AUROC condition
decision_tree.step1: n(A,RAW)=0 -> GENERIC_EVIDENCE_SHORTCUT_DOMINANT if shortcut criterion else INFORMATION_SUFFICIENCY_NOT_ESTABLISHED; n(A,RAW)=1 -> MIXED_OR_UNRESOLVED; n(A,RAW)>=2 -> step2
decision_tree.step4: n(B,RAW)=1 -> MIXED_OR_UNRESOLVED; n(B,RAW)=0 -> INFORMATION_EXISTS_BUT_OPEN_WORLD_TRANSFER_WEAK; n(B,RAW)>=2 and not rotOK(B,RAW) -> MIXED_OR_UNRESOLVED; else INFORMATION_SIGNAL_SUPPORTED
decision_tree.no_absolute_auroc: no absolute-AUROC threshold determines any Evidence claim

bootstrap.construction: rotation-stratified group-atomic (sample groups with replacement within each fold's test rows; per-rotation CIs restricted to that rotation's test rows)
bootstrap.class_coverage_guard: AUROC replicates require >=2 RK and >=2 TU rows per rotation; redraw (seeded) otherwise
bootstrap.retention_uncertainty: reporting-only 2.5/97.5 percentiles of per-replicate retention ratios (per family and median), with dropped-replicate counts

identity_checks: underlying-row zero overlap AND group zero overlap on all probe-A dev/test and probe-B train/threshold/test boundaries
P6 eval-row action reproduction = 0 mismatches vs stored action_P6_UTILITY_TYPED
SHUFFLED marginal preservation (mean/std within 1e-9, RK and TU separately)
hard_boundaries: no added models, no best-model selection, no tuning on held-out rotations
no Qwen / Model B / RL / RLAIF / continual learning
no modification of prior scientific results
